notes.title: Update 1.8.7 - RPG MAKER FES 2025
notes.notes:
[h1]Heróis de Noname - Early Acess Version 1.8.7[/h1]

[b]Update 1.8.7 - RPG Maker FES 2025[/b]

In celebration of RPG Maker FES 2025, I am releasing this simple update with rewards.

Usually I don't make announcements in English, but this time is a special occasion.
I plan to translate the game into English once it is finished, since I have finally managed to gather a solid team, the progress of the project will be faster and with better quality. (Don't pay attention to my paint placeholders, please....)
If you are reading this, I am grateful that my game caught your attention.
And I hope that even in another language you can enjoy it.
That said, have a good journey and in the future this journey will be in English.

Don't forget to join [url=https://discord.gg/Pd6QWKa9E9] our discord[/url] to follow updates and community events or even chat and play with us.
